environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

methodology.pyav_video_threads: AUTO with 2 decoder threads and 2 graph threads; graph-cycle collection included in each video call
methodology.timing: In-process function wall time; interpreter imports and fixture creation excluded; OS filesystem cache uncontrolled.
methodology.cache: Sample frame cache cleared outside timed misses; existing hit times reported separately.
methodology.scope: Audio/video decoding only, not full render speed; correctness failures are not usable speedups.
methodology.memory: Output array bytes only, not peak native or child-process RSS.
